Upon arrival, consulate personnel and Romania's Honorary Consul General, Masood Ahmad Qazi, greeted the visitors with floral bouquets and traditional hospitality at the motorway toll plaza and Peshawar Barracks. The delegation also toured the Peshawar Museum to learn about local historical heritage and received traditional turbans during a Pashtun welcome ceremony. A meeting followed with various officials, diplomats, and business leaders, including Advisor to the Governor Osman Saifullah Khan and former Sarhad Chamber chief Fuad Ishaq.

Discussions centered on leveraging Czech technology for mineral exploration and processing, facilitating textile machinery exchanges, and encouraging direct commercial linkages. Participants emphasized the region's mineral wealth, industrial base, and potential for skilled overseas employment. Ambassador Steinhübel noted that the trip marks a crucial milestone for economic ties, expressing a specific goal to elevate Czech exports and build partnerships with local businesses.

The engagement concluded with a traditional luncheon hosted by Barrister Assad Saifullah Khan. The meal featured regional delicacies from Lakki Marwat, such as Penda, Jawar ki Roti, and Saag, highlighting local culinary traditions and hospitality while aiming to foster practical business relationships.

stories.title: CDA Progresses on National Police Academy and Margalla Avenue Extension
stories.summary:
The Capital Development Authority has finalized over 96 percent of construction tasks on the 11-storey National Police Academy situated in Sector H-11. Meanwhile, the Sangjani Interchange and Margalla Avenue extension initiative has reached 41 percent completion. CDA Chairman and Islamabad Chief Commissioner Sohail Ashraf evaluated both urban development sites during inspections on November 17 and 18, urging officials to uphold strict construction quality and meet deadlines.

During his Wednesday tour of the academy, built in 15 months following directives from Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and the CDA chairman, Ashraf observed round-the-clock finishing efforts. The 11-storey facility incorporates a ground floor, a basement, and 126 rooms designed to offer advanced training infrastructure, featuring obstacle courses, rappelling towers, and a 7,442-metre track alongside landscaping and completed earthwork.

Earlier on Tuesday, during an inspection of the Margalla Avenue N-5 to M-1 extension and Sangjani Interchange, officials briefed Ashraf that 2.7 kilometres of the extension inside Islamabad Capital Territory boundaries are advancing continuously. Structural underpass elements and piling work for the interchange are finished, with girder launching anticipated soon. The chairman noted that this infrastructure will improve transit links between Islamabad and other regions, particularly aiding travelers from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Additionally, Ashraf reviewed progress at Babar Park, an initiative symbolizing friendship between Pakistan and Uzbekistan being built alongside Uzbek experts. The recreational space will offer sports courts, a modern library, jogging tracks, and a children's play area. The project aims to provide leisure amenities for local residents while enhancing historical and cultural connections between the two nations.

stories.title: پہلا پاکستانی خلا باز 25 نومبر کو چین کے مشن سے خلا میں جائے گا
stories.summary:
پاکستان کی خلائی تاریخ میں ایک نیا باب رقم ہونے جا رہا ہے، جہاں پہلا پاکستانی خلا باز آئندہ 25 نومبر کو چین کے شین ژو 24 مشن کے ذریعے خلا کی طرف روانہ ہوگا۔ اس تاریخی اقدام کو پاک چین خلائی تعاون میں ایک اہم سنگِ میل قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

سپارکو کے مطابق، دو پاکستانی امیدواروں محمد ذیشان علی اور خرم داؤد نے چین میں اپنی خلائی تربیت کامیابی سے مکمل کر لی ہے۔ ان دونوں میں سے ایک امیدوار بطور پے لوڈ اسپیشلسٹ اس خلائی سفر میں حصہ لے گا اور چین کے تیانگونگ خلائی اسٹیشن پر پہنچنے والا پہلا غیر ملکی خلا باز بنے گا۔

اس اہم مشن کے لوگو میں پاکستان کے قومی پھول چنبیلی کو بھی نمایاں مقام دیا گیا ہے۔ یہ سفر دونوں ملکوں کے درمیان سائنسی اور تکنیکی شعبوں میں بڑھتے ہوئے تعاون کی عکاسی کرتا ہے اور پاکستان کے لیے ایک قابل فخر لمحہ ہے۔

اس پیشرفت کا مقصد پاکستان کو خلائی تحقیق کے میدان میں آگے بڑھانا اور بین الاقوامی سطح پر ملک کا نام روشن کرنا ہے۔ اس تاریخی پرواز کے انتظامات حتمی مرحلے میں داخل ہو چکے ہیں اور پوری قوم کی نظریں اس منفرد مشن پر مرکوز ہیں۔

stories.title: Anthropic Sets Initial Public Offering Price at $83 per Share
stories.summary:
Anthropic has priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, surpassing its targeted range of $70 to $78. According to a person familiar with the matter who spoke on the condition of anonymity, this move marks one of the largest stock-market IPOs on record and the first by a major frontier artificial intelligence model developer. The offering size also increased from the initially planned 825 million shares.

This stock sale represents the second major AI-focused mega-IPO of the year, following SpaceX's offering in June. Investor enthusiasm remains high despite broader concerns regarding the escalating costs of developing and running AI models. The market backdrop for AI stocks has grown more difficult recently due to valuation worries, infrastructure expenses, and the sudden departure of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. Nevertheless, Anthropic's roadshow attracted demand exceeding the available shares.

Anthropic's rapid expansion is propelled by high demand for its Claude models, notably the coding agent Claude Code. As of October 31, its annualized revenue run rate hit $81 billion, growing from $71 billion a month prior. By September 30, the company served 11,900 customers generating at least $100,000 annually. However, this growth demands massive capital, with computing spending reaching nearly $9 billion in the first half of 2026 and an additional $5 billion in the third quarter. Third-quarter revenue rose 47 percent to $16.96 billion, while the operating loss hit $567 million, and net losses reached $23.3 billion.

The company has committed nearly $900 billion in computing contracts with partners like Amazon and Alphabet's Google. Anthropic warned in its prospectus that reliance on third-party financing by its infrastructure providers could delay or alter contracted capacity. Additionally, CEO Dario Amodei has previously advocated for slowing down the release of powerful models to manage societal risks. Trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT is expected to begin on Thursday, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading the 22-bank underwriting syndicate.

stories.title: Veerle Buurman Scores Late Winner to Send Chelsea Top of Women's Champions League
stories.summary:
Netherlands defender Veerle Buurman scored in the 87th minute to give Chelsea a 1-0 victory over Paris Saint-Germain, sending the English club to the top of the Women's Champions League league phase. The late strike placed Chelsea one point clear of last season's runners-up, Lyon, ahead of their respective fixtures. Midfielder Keira Walsh noted that finishing the evening at the top of the standings was a primary goal for the squad heading into the final match of the phase.

In other fifth-round fixtures, English champions Manchester City and Spain's Real Madrid secured vital victories to maintain pace near the top of the table. Manchester City defeated Swedish club Hacken 2-0, with second-half goals from Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw, moving City to fourth place on nine points. Real Madrid defeated 10-woman Inter Milan 3-1, bolstered by two late goals from substitute Signe Bruun after Lineth Beerensteyn opened the scoring and Inter's Michela Cambiaghi equalized following Karolina Vilhjalmsdottir's red card.

Meanwhile, Juventus also secured a 2-0 victory against Belgium's OH Leuven with late goals from Annamaria Serturini and Matilde Pavan in the final six minutes, placing them sixth in the standings. Several other matches, including Bayern Munich versus Austria Vienna and Lyon against Arsenal, were scheduled to take place the following day.

stories.title: Pakistan Finalizes Winter Gas Supply Strategy with 16 LNG Cargoes
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Petroleum Division has finalized a strategy to secure 16 Liquefied Natural Gas cargoes to guarantee uninterrupted gas distribution from November through February 2027. Long-term agreements with Qatar will cover a major portion of the supply, while short-term arrangements with the United States, Oman, and Azerbaijan's SOCAR will address remaining deficits.

During a media briefing on Wednesday, Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, along with Secretary Hamed Yaqoob Sheikh and spokesperson Zafar Abbas, detailed the sector's updates. Abbas noted that November gas demand is fully covered, three of four required December LNG cargoes are secured, and one of six January cargoes is locked in while negotiations continue for the rest. To tackle circular debt and restructure the gas sector, specialized consultants have been hired to separate the Regulated Gas Sector and the Commercial Gas Sector, targeting full transition by the end of 2027 in coordination with the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.

On the diplomatic and economic front, the minister announced upcoming trips to Oman for LPG and LNG cooperation agreements, the welcoming of a major Turkish vessel to port operations, and progress on the Hub Oil City project following a study by Technip Energies. Government deregulation has also yielded results, marked by Sui Southern Gas Company LPG Limited importing a record 15,000-metric-ton LPG cargo, the largest of its kind, which docked at EngroVopak Terminal Limited.

A welcome ceremony at Port Qasim was attended by officials including Special Secretary Petroleum Mirza Nasir ud Din Mashood, SLL Managing Director Jawad Ali Khan, and OGRA Senior Executive Director Sarmad Aslam. Officials emphasized that the record shipment will strengthen the supply chain, make LPG more affordable, and improve availability in remote and hilly areas during the peak winter season.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Updates Housing Finance and Developer Guidelines
stories.summary:
The State Bank of Pakistan has revised its guidelines governing builder and developer financing to boost the supply of mortgageable housing units and reinforce the country's housing finance ecosystem. The updated rules assist banks and Development Finance Institutions in extending financing to REITs, builders, and developers while maintaining prudent risk management aligned with corporate banking regulations and global best practices.

Under the new directives, financial institutions must create specialized units dedicated to expanding their builder and developer financing portfolios. To be eligible, a project team, REIT, builder, or developer must hold a valid building control authority license or a formal agreement with a public sector authority. Private entities must also demonstrate a strong track record of completed projects and possess clear, unencumbered land titles where the land value counts as sponsor equity. Furthermore, projects must generate enough cash flow for debt repayment, and independent technical feasibility reviews must be conducted by reputable engineering firms registered with bodies like the Pakistan Engineering Council.

Financial institutions are also required to obtain independent plot and project valuations from Pakistan Banks Association-approved valuers depending on the financing scale. Desktop valuations by the bank suffice for funding up to Rs50 million, at least one approved valuation is mandatory for amounts between Rs50 million and Rs500 million, and a minimum of two valuations are needed for sums exceeding Rs500 million.

Additionally, the State Bank mandated that banks and DFIs set up regular monitoring mechanisms during construction to track fund utilization properly. Financial institutions must audit project accounts and escrow accounts, and ensure that borrowers secure comprehensive insurance or Takaful coverage, such as a Contractor's All Risk Insurance Policy, for the entirety of the project.

stories.title: Public Private Partnership Authority Board Approves M-6 Motorway Sections
stories.summary:
The Public Private Partnership Authority (P3A) board cleared Sections I and II of the M-6 motorway during its 46th session. Headed by Privatisation Commission Chairman and Prime Minister Adviser on Privatisation Muhammad Ali, the board evaluated the roughly 121-kilometer stretch. Private investors will construct and manage each segment over a 25-year timeframe, recouping costs via toll collections before transferring the infrastructure back to the National Highway Authority in optimal condition. Viability Gap Funding will apply exclusively to Section I to ensure commercial feasibility and manageable tolls.

The broader 306-kilometer, six-lane M-6 project is structured across five sections to connect Hyderabad and Sukkur, reducing travel time from six hours to three. At present, traffic relies on the crowded N-5 National Highway, which passes through congested settlements and creates safety hazards with heavy freight. Financing for remaining sections between Nawabshah and Sukkur comes through sovereign loans from the OPEC Fund and Islamic Development Bank. The Asian Development Bank acts as the transaction adviser for the NHA.

This approval aligns with legislative plans under the Privatisation Commission (Amendment) Bill, 2026, which proposes merging P3A into the Privatisation Commission to form a single statutory body. This restructuring seeks to eliminate duplicate institutional hurdles and establish a streamlined framework for federal infrastructure and privatisation ventures. Active projects and funds will transition seamlessly under legal savings clauses.

Addressing a severe national infrastructure deficit where needs reach Rs4.1 trillion against a Rs1.126 trillion development budget, the framework utilizes private capital for highway, health, and energy projects. The legislation also introduces four ring-fenced funds to prevent costly project delays and enforces strict performance benchmarks for private operators.

stories.title: PAAPAM Requests Ministerial Intervention Over Automotive Bulb Import Restrictions
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Association of Automotive Parts and Accessories Manufacturers (PAAPAM) has appealed to Federal Minister for Energy Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari to speed up an amendment to SRO 547(I)/2023. The requested change aims to exclude incandescent and halogen bulbs utilized in vehicle headlamps from existing import limits. In his formal communication, PAAPAM Chairman Abdul Rehman Aizaz pointed out that the restrictions, originally enforced by the National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Authority, were meant for household and commercial markets rather than specialized automotive original equipment manufacturer parts.

According to the association, the Engineering Development Board convened an online session on October 20, 2026, where NEECA confirmed that including automotive incandescent bulbs was an inadvertent error. A summary for the necessary policy adjustment has already been forwarded to the Ministry of Energy's Power Division for cabinet evaluation. PAAPAM stresses the urgency of this clearance to prevent assembly disruptions for vehicle manufacturers.

Local companies have actively pursued component localization under SRO 655, initiating domestic headlamp assembly while continuing to import the specific internal bulbs. Because of the current regulatory bottleneck, several shipments of headlamp bulbs remain stranded at ports. This logjam threatens supply chains and risks halting assembly lines across original equipment manufacturers.

The association's ongoing appeals follow multiple letters sent through April, July, and October 2026 involving the Engineering Development Board and NEECA. PAAPAM emphasizes that these automotive components follow strict design protocols and should not be categorized alongside conventional domestic lighting, prompting its urgent plea to the minister for immediate relief.

stories.title: Retail Leaders Stress Technology and Economic Stability at Lahore Conference
stories.summary:
Key government representatives and commercial executives underscored the importance of economic stabilization, expanded regional commerce, and digital integration during the 6th Future of Retail Conference in Lahore. Hosted by the Chainstore Association of Pakistan, the event focused on maximizing the potential of the country's structured retail market.

During the event, Rana Ehsan Afzal, Coordinator to the Prime Minister on Commerce, noted that much of the chain-store network operates within the documented framework. He reported a per capita income around USD 1,900, an economic growth rate of 3.7 percent, and regional trade restricted to nearly five percent. He emphasized that future state policies would prioritize stakeholder dialogues and structural reforms rather than introducing additional tax burdens.

Khurram Shehzad, Adviser to the Federal Finance Minister, highlighted macroeconomic improvements, noting the fiscal deficit declined to 2.6 percent—a 22-year low—while inflation fell from 29 percent to roughly seven percent alongside a 15 percent expansion in private-sector financing. Additional remarks came from Tourism Coordinator Sardar Yasir Ilyas Khan, who pointed to travel as a growth catalyst, and Punjab Chief Minister Adviser Ali Dar, who asserted that advanced data and artificial intelligence will drive future retail success.

Concluding the sessions, Chainstore Association Patron-in-Chief Rana Tariq Mehboob advocated for supportive commercial policies. Meanwhile, All Pakistan Textile Mills Association Chairman Asad Shafi addressed the textile sector's core strengths alongside the operational hurdles faced by smaller merchants operating on narrow profit margins.

stories.title: Weather Report and Regional Temperature Forecasts Across Major Pakistani Cities
stories.summary:
Weather observations for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, and forecasts for Thursday, November 19, 2026, detail temperature ranges across major urban centers in Pakistan. In southern regions, Hyderabad recorded temperatures between 32 and 18 degrees Celsius, with forecasts anticipating 32 to 17 degrees Celsius. Karachi experienced temperatures ranging from 33 to 17 degrees Celsius, expected to shift to 33 and 16 degrees Celsius the following day.

Central and northern areas experienced cooler conditions. Lahore reported a range of 27 to 11 degrees Celsius, maintaining identical parameters for the upcoming forecast. Larkana registered 30 to 14 degrees Celsius, shifting to 30 to 15 degrees Celsius. Mirpurkhas noted 32 to 16 degrees Celsius, forecasted at 32 to 15 degrees Celsius. Muzaffarabad recorded 23 to 9 degrees Celsius, with a slight adjustment to 22 to 10 degrees Celsius.

Peshawar observed temperatures between 27 and 12 degrees Celsius, dropping to 24 to 12 degrees Celsius. Quetta remained the coldest tracked city, maintaining a steady range of 21 to 4 degrees Celsius across both days. Rawalpindi recorded 24 to 9 degrees Celsius, expected to reach 23 to 10 degrees Celsius. Sukkur logged 30 to 14 degrees Celsius, with a subsequent forecast of 30 to 15 degrees Celsius.

Additionally, local timings for Karachi indicated sunset at 5:43 PM on Wednesday and sunrise scheduled for 6:50 AM on Thursday, according to Business Recorder data.

stories.title: JI Chief Criticizes Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari Over New Provinces and Political History
stories.summary:
Jamaat-e-Islami Chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman recently advised Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari to examine his party's political background before speaking against the establishment of new provinces. Speaking at a press conference alongside other party officials in Islamabad, Hafiz challenged Bilawal to present Form 45s for the seven National Assembly seats the PPP secured in Karachi during the previous elections. He also reminded the PPP leader of his party's involvement in the ethnic tensions caused by the 1972 Language Bill in Sindh before warning against potential bloodshed over new administrative boundaries, emphasizing that any new units must be created through proper constitutional procedures.

During the briefing, the JI chief also highlighted political inconsistencies within the ruling arrangement, noting that while the PPP calls the federal government illegitimate, President Asif Zardari assumed office with its backing. He urged Zardari to resign if the administration lacks legitimacy. Hafiz further accused the PPP of manipulating Karachi's mayoral contest, questioned Bilawal's recent sympathy toward the PTI, and recalled that Zardari previously endorsed governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa despite current opposition from the party.

Turning to economic and public issues, Hafiz announced that the JI will organize sit-ins outside sugar mills on Friday, November 20, to protest delays in the sugarcane crushing season. He pointed out that farmers struggle with high costs for agricultural inputs and demanded a minimum sugarcane price of Rs700 per maund, criticizing influential political families like the Sharifs and Zardaris for owning sugar mills. Furthermore, he addressed soaring flour prices, substandard wheat in Sindh, and excessive profits made by oil companies during recent crises.

Finally, the JI leader raised concerns regarding public utilities and governance, pointing out severe gas shortages where consumers cannot buy liquefied petroleum gas at official prices and criticizing daily payments of $538,000 to liquefied natural gas terminals despite a lack of imports. He additionally held the federal government responsible for the repeated postponement of local government elections in Islamabad, marking the sixth time the polls have been delayed.

stories.title: Pakistan and China Agree to Enhance Law Enforcement and Security Coordination
stories.summary:
Pakistan and China reached an agreement to deepen coordination and expand cooperative efforts between their respective law enforcement agencies during a high-level meeting in Islamabad on Wednesday. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong convened to review the bilateral strategic partnership, security collaboration, and ways to make joint operations between law enforcement bodies more proactive and effective.

A key decision emerging from the discussions was that Chinese instructors will soon travel to Pakistan to deliver language training to personnel within the Special Protection Unit. Additionally, Ambassador Jiang confirmed China's ongoing backing for the construction of a Law Enforcement Centre in Islamabad, which is being modeled after Chinese infrastructure standards, reaffirming Beijing's dedication to providing comprehensive assistance for the initiative.

The meeting also underscored appreciation for the ongoing administrative efforts in Pakistan. Ambassador Jiang commended Interior Minister Naqvi for his proactive stance in facilitating full cooperation and ensuring the swift resolution of matters concerning bilateral projects and security.

Several senior Pakistani officials were present alongside the interior minister during the consultations. Attendees included State Minister for Talal Chaudry, the Federal Interior Secretary, and the Director General of the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency, reflecting the high priority both nations place on institutional security cooperation.

stories.title: ECP Issues Detailed Verdict Emphasizing Timely Local Government Elections in Islamabad
stories.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan released a detailed verdict regarding the delay of local government elections in the Islamabad Capital Territory, stressing that no legal or administrative hurdles should prevent the timely establishment of elected local bodies. The comprehensive order was issued by a five-member full bench headed by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja, alongside members Nisar Ahmed Durrani, Shah Muhammad Jatoi, Babar Hassan Bharwana, and Justice Ikram Ullah Khan.

The background of the electoral process dates back to July of this year, when the ECP initiated constituency delimitations following the promulgation of the ICT Local Government Amendment Ordinance by the federal government. Although the delimitation phase concluded in October, the temporary ordinance expired in September without being successfully passed as a bill by both houses of Parliament, despite being cleared by the National Assembly's interior panel.

Previously, the full ECP bench instructed its secretariat to immediately release an election schedule based on the older ICT Local Government Act of 2015. However, the commission had to suspend its preparations for the upcoming December 20 polls for nearly two weeks following an intervention by the Islamabad High Court.

A single-judge bench of the high court, consisting of Justice Umair Majeed Malik, granted a stay order until the next hearing scheduled for November 26. This legal pause came in response to a writ petition filed by Chaudhry Amjad Ali, which challenged the execution of the local polls until the constituency delimitation status in the capital territory is legally finalized.

stories.title: Lawyer Demands Jailed Imran Khan's Transfer to Private Hospital Over Care Concerns
stories.summary:
Legal representation for detained former prime minister Imran Khan formally demanded his immediate transfer from Adiala Jail to a private hospital on Wednesday. In a legal notice served to the jail superintendent, lawyer Khalid Yusuf Chaudhry accused prison authorities of ignoring court directives regarding adequate medical attention and standard detention conditions for the incarcerated leader.

The notice referenced a Supreme Court order from August 18, which mandated comprehensive medical facilities for Khan, and alleged that authorities improperly transferred him to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences instead of Shifa International Hospital. Furthermore, the legal filing invoked an Islamabad High Court ruling concerning Khan's rights to family visits, electronic communication with his sons in the United Kingdom, access to reading materials and television, and daily outdoor exercise, arguing that his current isolation cannot be justified on security grounds.

In a related political development, PTI-backed opposition leader in the Senate Allama Raja Nasir Abbas challenged PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari to prove his dedication to democracy and constitutional supremacy. Responding to Bilawal's recent remarks, Abbas urged the PPP to request the resignation of its governor in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and help restore the elected provincial government.

Abbas emphasized that political actions carry more weight than public statements, asserting that if the PPP truly believes in democratic values, it must take concrete steps to reverse governor's rule in the province. He maintained that the nation cannot move forward without absolute respect for the constitution and called on Bilawal to support PTI's demands for the restoration of the regional administration.

stories.title: Pakistani Foreign Minister Welcomes Bangladeshi Civil Servants in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar formally addressed a group of 35 senior civil servants from Bangladesh at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Islamabad on Wednesday. The visiting delegates are currently taking part in an Executive Leadership Training Programme managed by the Executive Development Institute at the National School of Public Policy, operating under the framework of the Pakistan-Bangladesh Knowledge Corridor.

During the meeting, the Deputy Prime Minister warmly greeted the delegation while emphasizing the deep historical bonds of friendship and cultural ties connecting Pakistan and Bangladesh. He acknowledged the constructive momentum currently present in bilateral relations, reaffirming Pakistan's dedication to reinforcing these ties through mutual trust, respect, and goodwill.

Mr. Dar specifically pointed out the important function of the Knowledge Corridor in advancing educational initiatives, professional training schemes, and institutional exchanges between the two nations. He shared his optimism that the training initiative would provide a valuable platform for participants to exchange practical insights regarding public administration and governance.

Furthermore, the Foreign Minister noted that the programme would help cultivate lasting professional connections and personal friendships among the attendees. He concluded his address by wishing all the visiting delegates a memorable and highly productive stay in Pakistan.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari Says Centre Criticizes Him for Speaking Truth About New Provinces
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari responded to sharp criticisms from federal ministers on Wednesday night, asserting that politicians are attacking him because they lack the courage to hear the truth. The ongoing political clash was sparked by Bilawal's vocal opposition to proposals floated by federal figures regarding the creation of new provinces. Federal ministers, including Health Minister Mustafa Kamal and Defence Minister Khawaja Asif, had argued that smaller provinces are essential for better governance and must be decided through public opinion. They also questioned the PPP's historical stances on administrative divisions.

Bilawal maintained that this major debate over reforming the system was initiated without consulting key political stakeholders, including the prime minister or allied leaders. He criticized the administration for conducting the debate selectively and questioned who gave entities like the Pakistan Cricket Board chairman the authority to declare the system collapsed and dictate a reset. Reflecting on regional history, the PPP chief warned that pushing forward with divisive agendas, particularly regarding Sindh, could trigger severe unrest and instability. He noted his past remarks served as a precautionary alarm rather than a threat.

Addressing broader political reforms, Bilawal defended the 27th Amendment and the creation of a constitutional court as historic milestones that he will not abandon. As a starting point for democratic recovery, he suggested returning reserved seats to the opposition to rebuild trust, though he clarified this was only a recommendation. He also questioned the treatment of political prisoners, specifically mentioning PTI founder Imran Khan.

Despite ongoing tensions and disagreements with the ruling coalition's treatment of partners, Bilawal affirmed that he continues to support Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. He emphasized that the primary expectation of ordinary citizens is for leadership to solve pressing economic problems rather than engage in political squabbling over administrative boundaries.

stories.title: کراچی میں سپر ہائی وے ٹول پلازہ کے قریب حادثے میں نوجوان جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کراچی میں سپر ہائی وے پر حیدرآباد سے کراچی آتے ہوئے ایک ٹریفک حادثے میں ایک نوجوان جاں بحق ہو گیا ہے۔ یہ حادثہ ٹول پلازہ کے قریب ستارہ ہلال پمپ کے نزدیک پیش آیا۔

ریسکیو حکام کے مطابق حادثے میں جان کی بازی ہارنے والے نوجوان کی شناخت علیان کے نام سے ہوئی ہے۔

حکام نے لاش کو ضروری کارروائی کے لیے عباسی شہید اسپتال منتقل کر دیا ہے۔ حادثے کی مزید تفصیلات فوری طور پر سامنے نہیں آ سکی ہیں۔

stories.title: Pat Cummins Defiant as Fresh Ball-Tampering Claims Rock Australian Cricket
stories.summary:
Australian Test captain Pat Cummins faced intense scrutiny on Thursday after fresh allegations regarding the infamous 2018 "Sandpapergate" ball-tampering scandal emerged from Cameron Bancroft. Bancroft, the player who used sandpaper during a Test match in Cape Town, stated in a newspaper column that the entire Australian team was aware of the plot. These remarks directly contradicted Cummins' assertions made during a 70-minute press conference where he forcefully denied any prior knowledge of the plan.

Following Bancroft's latest statements, calls quickly mounted from various media outlets and commentators for Cummins' captaincy to be reviewed. Publications such as The Australian and the national broadcaster ABC questioned the truthfulness of the captain's denials and the viability of his leadership position. Meanwhile, Cricket Australia stated that it would not reopen its 2018 investigation, choosing instead to establish a forum for players to share their experiences from that period.

Chief Executive Todd Greenberg defended the captain, asserting that Cummins' version of the events was not under scrutiny and that he did not need to be cleared. Bancroft's revelations also implicated former vice-captain David Warner as the person who first raised the idea during a Test in Port Elizabeth, and noted that coaches Darren Lehmann and David Saker were present during discussions. Lehmann, who resigned shortly after the Cape Town incident, stated he needed time to process the new allegations.

The scandal continues to reverberate through Australian cricket as the team prepares to announce its squad for the upcoming home Test series against New Zealand. While Cummins' agent maintained that the skipper had already addressed all questions during his press conference, the ongoing controversy has left the future of the Test captaincy under a heavy cloud of public and media debate.

stories.title: آرمی چیف فیلڈ مارشل عاصم منیر کا تربت کا دورہ، امن کے عزم کا اعادہ
stories.summary:
چیف آف آرمی اسٹاف و چیف آف ڈیفنس فورسز فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے بلوچستان کے علاقے تربت کا دورہ کیا ہے۔ تربت پہنچنے پر کور کمانڈر بلوچستان نے ان کا استقبال کیا، جبکہ انہوں نے یادگار شہدا پر پھولوں کی چادر چڑھائی اور فاتحہ خوانی کی۔

دورے کے دوران آرمی چیف کو بلوچستان کی موجودہ سیکیورٹی صورتحال، آپریشنل تیاریوں اور بیرونی سرپرستی میں ہونے والی دہشت گردی کے خلاف جاری کامیاب کارروائیوں کے بارے میں تفصیلی بریفنگ دی گئی۔ انہیں صوبے کے عوام کی سماجی و معاشی ترقی کے لیے جاری مختلف ترقیاتی منصوبوں پر پیش رفت سے بھی آگاہ کیا گیا۔

فیلڈ مارشل عاصم منیر نے مشکل آپریشنل حالات میں جوانوں کی اعلیٰ پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیتوں، تیاری اور وطن کے دفاع کے لیے ان کے غیر متزلزل عزم کو سراہا۔ انہوں نے اس بات کا اعادہ کیا کہ پاک فوج بلوچستان کے عوام کے ساتھ شانہ بشانہ کھڑی ہے اور صوبے میں امن، خوشحالی اور پائیدار ترقی کے فروغ کے لیے اپنا کردار ادا کرتی رہے گی۔

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Secures ATP Finals Semi-Final Berth with Help from Frances Tiafoe
stories.summary:
Carlos Alcaraz advanced to the semi-finals of the ATP Finals on Wednesday following a straight-sets victory over Daniil Medvedev and subsequent assistance from American player Frances Tiafoe. Playing at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy, the Spanish star needed just over 70 minutes to defeat world number five Medvedev 6-2, 6-4. Despite experiencing minor physical issues and requiring his left thigh to be taped up in the second set, Alcaraz maintained control of the match to secure his progression.

Alcaraz's advancement was confirmed later in the day when Frances Tiafoe defeated Italy's Flavio Cobolli 7-6, 6-0. Tiafoe's victory in the first set guaranteed the Spanish player a spot in the next round of the season-ending tournament. Alcaraz entered the competition carrying a nine-match winning streak after capturing indoor titles in Vienna and at the Paris Masters, making him a leading favorite to claim the trophy, especially with last year's champion Jannik Sinner sidelined by injury.

Reflecting on his performance against Medvedev, Alcaraz explained that he chose to play smoothly and avoid pushing his physical limits after securing a break in the second set. The 23-year-old seven-time Grand Slam champion previously reached the final last year, where he finished as the runner-up to Sinner. His strong form in Turin follows a successful return to the tour in August after a four-month absence caused by a wrist injury that forced him to miss defending his French Open title.

With Alcaraz securing his place in the final four, Medvedev remains in contention to advance from the group stage pending his final match against Tiafoe on Friday. In the other group, world number one Alexander Zverev became the first player to book a semi-final spot after defeating Ben Shelton.

stories.title: عالمی امن کے لیے پاکستان نے 183 جوانوں کی قربانی دی، وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے بیلجیم کے دارالحکومت برسلز میں یورپی پارلیمنٹ کے اندر منعقدہ شومان سکیورٹی اینڈ الدفاع فورم سے خطاب کیا۔ اپنے خطاب کے دوران انہوں نے عالمی امن و سلامتی کے حوالے سے پاکستان کے کردار کو اجاگر کیا اور بتایا کہ ملک نے گزشتہ سات دہائیوں کے دوران اقوام متحدہ کے اڑتالیس امن مشنز میں دو لاکھ سینتیس ہزار سکیورٹی اہلکار روانہ کیے ہیں۔

وزیر دفاع نے اس بات پر روشنی ڈالی کہ ان بین الاقوامی امن مشنز کے دوران پاکستان کے ایک سو تراسی اہلکاروں نے اپنے فرائض کی ادائیگی کے دوران اپنی جانوں کا نذرانہ پیش کیا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ یہ عظیم قربانیاں اور خدمات اس بات کا واضح ثبوت ہیں کہ پاکستان ایک فعال اور ذمہ دار عالمی کردار ادا کر رہا ہے اور دنیا میں پائیدار امن کے قیام کا خواہاں ہے۔

خواجہ آصف نے خبردار کیا کہ تنازعات سے دوچار علاقوں میں اقوام متحدہ کے امن مشنز میں اچانک کمی واقع ہونے کی صورت میں انسانی سلامتی کے خطرات مزید سنگین شکل اختیار کر سکتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ امن مشنز کے دائرہ کار کو زمینی حقائق کے مطابق ڈھالنا چاہیے، انہیں مناسب وسائل سے لیس کیا جائے اور دیرپا سیاسی حل کے ساتھ منسلک کیا جائے۔

اپنے خطاب کے آخر میں انہوں نے اس امر پر بھی زور دیا کہ موسمیاتی تبدیلی، غذائی عدم تحفظ اور معاشی کمزوریاں دنیا بھر کے تنازعات کو مزید ہوا دے رہی ہیں۔ انہوں نے مطالبہ کیا کہ دیرینہ عالمی تنازعات کا حل بین الاقوامی قوانین اور اقوام متحدہ کی قراردادوں کے عین مطابق نکالا جانا چاہیے۔

stories.title: بھارت کا پانی کو بطور ہتھیار استعمال کرنا عالمی قانون کی خلاف ورزی ہے، پاکستان
stories.summary:
پاکستان نے بھارت کی جانب سے سندھ طاس معاہدے کو یکطرفہ اور غیر قانونی طور پر معطل کیے جانے کے اقدام کو سختی کے ساتھ مسترد کر دیا ہے۔ پاکستان نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا ہے کہ دریاؤں کا پانی روکنے کی دھمکیاں دینا بین الاقوامی قوانین کی کھلم کھلا خلاف ورزی ہے، جو چوبیس کروڑ سے زائد افراد کے روزگار اور فلاح و بہبود کے لیے ایک بڑا خطرہ ہونے کے ساتھ ساتھ علاقائی امن کے بھی منافی ہے۔

یہ مؤقف اقوام متحدہ کی سلامتی کے رکن ملک لائبیریا کے زیر اہتمام منعقدہ آریا فارمولا اجلاس سے خطاب کے دوران پاکستان کے نائب مستقل مندوب سفیر عثمان جادون نے پیش کیا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ مستقل ثالثی عدالت کے اکیس اگست دو ہزار چھبیس کے فیصلے نے اس بات کی مکمل تصدیق کی ہے کہ سندھ طاس معاہدہ تاحال نافذ العمل ہے اور بھارت اس کے تحت اپنی تمام تر قانونی ذمہ داریوں سے بندھا ہوا ہے۔

سفیر عثمان جادون نے عالمی برادری کو خبردار کیا کہ کسی بھی ریاست کو اس بات کی ہرگز اجازت نہیں دی جا سکتی کہ وہ مشترکہ قدرتی وسائل کو بین الاقوامی قوانین کی پامالی کرتے ہوئے سیاسی دباؤ کے حربے کے طور پر استعمال کرے۔ انہوں نے سلامتی کونسل کی قرارداد اٹھائیس اٹھاسی کا حوالہ دیتے ہوئے اقوام متحدہ کے منشور کے آرٹیکل تینتیس کے تحت مشترکہ سرحد پار قدرتی وسائل کے منصفانہ انتظام اور پرامن حل کی ضرورت پر زور دیا۔

اجلاس کے دوران انہوں نے قدرتی وسائل سے متعلق تنازعات کی روک تھام کے لیے تین اہم ترجیحات بھی بیان کیں، جن میں بنیادی سیاسی وجوہات کا حل، سپلائی چین میں شفافیت اور ترقی پذیر ممالک کو ٹیکنالوجی کی منتقلی شامل ہیں۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ قدرتی وسائل کو باہمی تنازعات کا نہیں بلکہ پائیدار ترقی اور خوشحالی کا ذریعہ بنایا جانا چاہیے۔

stories.title: Submarine Cable Fault Disrupts Internet Across Pakistan
stories.summary:
Internet users throughout Pakistan encountered slow speeds and intermittent connectivity following a technical failure in an international submarine cable system on Wednesday night. According to the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, the disruption stems from a fault in the SEA-ME-WE 5 cable system, located approximately eleven kilometres off the coast of the country.

Transworld Associates, the operator of the landing site in Pakistan, is working alongside the SMW5 Consortium to pinpoint the source of the malfunction and establish an estimated time for restoration. The situation matters because reliable web access is vital for daily communications, commerce, and operational continuity nationwide.

To mitigate the impact and maintain services as much as possible, officials stated that digital traffic is being redirected through alternative international channels. Authorities have not yet provided a specific timeline for when full connectivity will be completely restored.

The regulatory body announced that it remains in close communication with all relevant stakeholders while keeping a close watch on developments. Monitoring will persist to ensure standard internet operations return to the nation at the earliest opportunity.

stories.title: مخالفین بھی مان رہے ہیں بانی سیاسی قیدی ہیں، بیرسٹر گوہر
stories.summary:
تحریک انصاف کے چیئرمین بیرسٹر گوہر نے کہا ہے کہ سیاسی مخالفین بھی تسلیم کر رہے ہیں کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی ایک سیاسی قیدی ہیں۔ میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ بند دروازوں کے پیچھے اور رات کی تاریکی میں سزائیں سنائی گئیں، اس لیے عدالت سے درخواست ہے کہ دن کی روشنی میں کھلی عدالت کے اندر ان کا مؤقف سنا جائے۔ دوسری جانب پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے کہا ہے کہ سسٹم کے خاتمے، سسٹم کی تشکیلِ نو اور ریفرنڈم سے نئے صوبے بنانے کی بحث کا آغاز انہوں نے نہیں کیا، اور اگر ایسی بحث چھڑی تو کوئی ایک آواز نہیں ہوگی۔

امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان تنازع کے باعث رواں برس اپریل میں پاکستان میں پیٹرولیم مصنوعات کی قیمتیں بلند ترین سطح پر پہنچ گئیں۔ نائب وزیراعظم اور دیگر حکومتی وزراء نے بھی مختلف امور پر بات چیت کی جبکہ قومی نصاب سے متعلق پالیسی کی عدم تشکیل پر بھی تشویش ظاہر کی گئی۔ اس کے علاوہ گندم اور آٹے کی قیمتوں میں اضافے کے بعد فلاحی ملوں اور چکی کا آٹا بھی بیس روپے فی کلو مہنگا ہو گیا ہے۔

سنگاپور میں ایس ایم ای فنانس فورم 2026 سے خطاب کے دوران سینیٹر اورنگزیب نے بتایا کہ پاکستان کے نوے فیصد کاروبار مجموعی قومی پیداوار کا چالیس فیصد ہیں۔ مظفرآباد میں وزیراعظم آزاد کشمیر کے زیرِ صدارت ایک اجلاس منعقد ہوا جس میں ترقیاتی پلان کے لیے تمام وسائل فراہم کرنے کا اعلان کیا گیا۔ اس دوران گدھے اور کتوں کا گوشت برآمد کرنے پر فوڈ اتھارٹی کی مدعی میں نامعلوم افراد کے خلاف مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا جبکہ پاکستان ٹیلی کمیونیکیشن اتھارٹی نے سب میرین کیبل ایس ایم ڈبلیو فائیو میں فالٹ آنے کی تصدیق کی۔

پیپلز پارٹی کی رہنما شازیہ مری کا کہنا ہے کہ اختلافِ رائے جمہوریت کا بنیادی حق ہے اور کوئی جرم نہیں۔ وزیر دفاع خواجہ محمد آصف نے بلاول بھٹو کے ریفرنڈم سے متعلق بیان پر اعتراض اٹھایا جبکہ وزیراعلیٰ سندھ مراد علی شاہ نے بھی اس مباحثے پر ردعمل ظاہر کیا۔ یہ تمام سیاسی اور معاشی جزیات ملک میں جاری کشیدہ سیاسی و معاشی صورتحال کی عکاسی کرتے ہیں۔

stories.title: کراچی میں تین مختلف پولیس مقابلے، تین زخمیوں سمیت چار ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں پولیس اور مبینہ قانون شکنی کرنے والوں کے درمیان فائرنگ کے تین الگ الگ مقابلے پیش آئے، جن کے نتیجے میں تین زخمیوں سمیت چار ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا۔ پولیس نے تمام زخمی ملزمان کو فوری طور پر طبی امداد کی فراہمی کے لیے شہر کے مختلف اسپتالوں میں منتقل کر دیا ہے۔

پہلا مبینہ پولیس مقابلہ جمشید کوارٹر کے علاقے جہانگیر روڈ پر پیش آیا جہاں فائرنگ کے تبادلے کے بعد ایک ڈاکو کو زخمی حالت میں دبوچ لیا گیا۔ چھیپا ذرائع کے مطابق اس زخمی ملزم کی شناخت وقاص عرف کالا کے نام سے ہوئی ہے جسے پولیس تحویل میں سول اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا، اور اس کے قبضے سے ایک عدد اسلحہ بھی برآمد کر لیا گیا۔

دوسرا مقابلہ گلبہار کے علاقے میں لیاری ایکسپریس وے کے قریب حاجی مرید گوٹھ میں ہوا جہاں پولیس اور ملزمان کے درمیان فائرنگ کا تبادلہ ہوا۔ اس واقعے میں چالیس سالہ اشفاق ولد مختیار حسین نامی ملزم زخمی ہوا جسے امدادی کارکنوں نے ایمبولینس کے ذریعے عباسی شہید اسپتال پہنچایا۔

تیسرا مبینہ مقابلہ زمان ٹاؤن پولیس نے کورنگی کراسنگ کی بھٹائی کالونی میں کیا۔ اس کارروائی کے دوران پولیس نے دو ڈاکوؤں کو گرفتار کیا جن میں سے ایک زخمی حالت میں تھا اور اس کی شناخت علی اصغر کے طور پر ہوئی جسے جناح اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا جبکہ دوسرے ساتھی جنید کو تھانے منتقل کر دیا گیا۔ پولیس نے ان تمام ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ اور موٹرسائیکلیں بھی برآمد کر لیں۔

stories.title: Rockstar Reveals Major Technical and Gameplay Leaps in GTA VI
stories.summary:
Thirteen years following the initial release of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto V, the gaming industry prepares for the arrival of GTA VI. The forthcoming title represents a monumental leap in hardware capabilities, game design, and overall scale compared to its predecessor, which famously featured three playable protagonists across the massive Los Santos map modeled after Los Angeles.

Set in the fictional state of Leonida, which is based on Florida, GTA VI transports players to a newly expanded map featuring the neon-filled Vice City, lush wetlands, island shores, and small communities. Unlike GTA V's trio of Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor Philips, the new title highlights the criminal partnership of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, marking the first time a female character takes a starring role in the modern HD era of the franchise.

Technological demands have escalated dramatically, with GTA VI requiring an estimated 212GB to 300GB of free space. This massive footprint supports highly detailed individual character models, heavily rendered interiors, and a new global illumination system that delivers hyper-realistic ray-traced lighting. In contrast to the physical multi-disc packaging of GTA V in 2013, the new installment heavily emphasizes online distribution, with boxed physical copies sold strictly as digital download codes rather than optical discs.

Designed natively for modern hardware, GTA VI builds upon the open-world physics and lighting standards established by GTA V over a decade ago. The advancements aim to push current gaming technology to its absolute limits, particularly in rendering complex environments like Vice City's vibrant nightlife and advanced water physics.

stories.title: لندن میں پاکستانی ہائی کمیشن نے نادرا اور ویزا سروسز معطل کر دیں
stories.summary:
برطانیہ میں مقیم پاکستانی شہریوں کو اس وقت عارضی مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے کیونکہ پاکستان ہائی کمیشن لندن نے نادرا، پاسپورٹ اور ویزا سروسز کو اگلے احکامات تک معطل کر دیا ہے۔ یہ قدم ہنگامی بنیادوں پر اٹھایا گیا ہے۔

اس تعطل کی بنیادی وجہ زیرِ سمندر انٹرنیٹ کیبل میں تکنیکی خرابی ہے، جس کے باعث انٹرنیٹ کنیکٹیویٹی شدید متاثر ہوئی ہے۔ انٹرنیٹ نظام خراب ہونے کی وجہ سے متعلقہ تمام آن لائن سرکاری خدمات بھی فی الحال معطل ہو چکی ہیں۔

ہائی کمیشن کے جاری کردہ اعلامیے کے مطابق، جب تک انٹرنیٹ نظام مکمل طور پر بحال نہیں ہو جاتا، شہریوں کو یہ آن لائن سہولیات فراہم نہیں کی جا سکیں گی۔ تاہم، اس دوران دستاویزات کی تصدیق کا عمل معمول کے مطابق جاری رہے گا۔

حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ معطل شدہ خدمات کی بحالی کے بارے میں عوام کو آئندہ اطلاع کے ذریعے باضابطہ طور پر آگاہ کیا جائے گا۔ شہریوں سے گزارش کی گئی ہے کہ وہ اس عارضی خلل کے دوران تعاون کریں اور نئی معلومات کا انتظار کریں۔

stories.title: Turkish Winger Arda Guler Signs Six-Year Contract Extension With Real Madrid
stories.summary:
Real Madrid has officially announced that Turkish winger Arda Guler has signed a new six-year contract extension, tying him to the club until 2032. His previous agreement was set to run until 2029. The announcement comes as the 21-year-old continues to feature prominently for the Spanish giants, having made appearances in 14 of the team's 16 games this campaign while contributing four goals and seven assists.

This roster stability follows a busy period of squad development for Real Madrid, which previously secured Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig for a club-record 140 million euros ($157m) following his standout performances at the 2026 World Cup. Diomande recently demonstrated his value by scoring a notable strike against Sevilla in La Liga, ahead of a scheduled Champions League meeting against his former club, Leipzig.

Club President Florentino Perez initiated major investments of this scale following a pledge made during his reelection campaign in June. With the club pursuing an aggressive squad rebuild after enduring two consecutive seasons without capturing a major trophy, the leadership committed significant capital to acquire elite young talent.

The long-term signing of Guler highlights Real Madrid's ongoing strategy to secure its core young players for the future. As the team balances domestic commitments in La Liga with European competition, retaining impactful performers like the young Turkish international remains central to the club's long-term competitive framework.

stories.title: شدید دھند کی وجہ سے موٹروے ایم 4 مختلف مقامات پر بند کر دی گئی
stories.summary:
لاہور اور گردونواح میں شدید دھند کے باعث ٹریفک کی روانی بری طرح متاثر ہوئی ہے، جس کے پیش نظر موٹروے ایم 4 کو مختلف حصوں میں ٹریفک کے لیے بند کر دیا گیا ہے۔ ترجمان موٹروے پولیس سید عمران احمد کے مطابق یہ فیصلہ مسافروں کی جان و مال کے تحفظ کے لیے کیا گیا ہے۔

ابتدائی طور پر حدِ نگاہ کم ہونے پر ایم 4 کو عبدالحکیم سے پنڈی بھٹیاں تک صرف ہیوی ٹریفک کے لیے روکا گیا تھا، لیکن دھند کی شدت میں مزید اضافہ ہونے کے بعد فیصل آباد سے پنڈی بھٹیاں تک ہر قسم کی ٹریفک کی آمدورفت معطل کر دی گئی ہے۔

موٹروے پولیس نے شہریوں کو ہدایت کی ہے کہ وہ دھند کے اس موسم میں غیر ضروری سفر سے گریز کریں اور انتہائی مجبوری کی صورت میں دن کی روشنی، بالخصوص صبح 10 بجے سے شام 6 بجے کے درمیان سفر کو ترجیح دیں۔

ڈرائیوروں کو یہ بھی تاکید کی گئی ہے کہ وہ گاڑیوں میں فوگ لائٹس کا استعمال کریں، رفتار کم رکھیں، اگلی گاڑی سے مناسب فاصلہ برقرار رکھیں اور غیر ضروری اوورٹیکنگ سے گریز کریں تاکہ ممکنہ حادثات سے بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: امریکی تحقیقی ادارے نے 2035 تک دنیا میں اسلام کے غلبے کی پیش گوئی کر دی
stories.summary:
عالمی مذہبی منظرنامے میں ایک بڑی تبدیلی متوقع ہے، اور ایک امریکی تحقیقی ادارے پیو ریسرچ سینٹر کے آبادیاتی تخمینوں کے مطابق سال 2035 تک اسلام دنیا کا سب سے بڑا مذہب بن سکتا ہے۔ اس سال تک مسلمانوں کی تعداد عیسائیوں سے بڑھنے کا امکان ظاہر کیا گیا ہے۔

رپورٹ کے مطابق، 2035 تک دنیا بھر میں مسلمانوں کی آبادی بڑھ کر تقریباً 2 ارب 57 کروڑ تک پہنچ جائے گی، جبکہ عیسائی آبادی کے 2 ارب 52 کروڑ رہنے کی توقع ہے۔ آبادی میں اس اضافے کی بڑی وجوہات میں مسلمانوں میں نسبتاً زیادہ شرح پیدائش اور نوجوان آبادی کا تناسب شامل ہیں۔

اس تحقیق میں پاکستان کے حوالے سے بھی ایک اہم اور دلچسپ پیش گوئی کی گئی ہے۔ اندازہ لگایا گیا ہے کہ سال 2070 تک پاکستان میں مسلمانوں کی تعداد تقریباً 46 کروڑ ہو جائے گی، جس کے بعد پاکستان انڈونیشیا کو پیچھے چھوڑ کر دنیا کی سب سے بڑی مسلم آبادی والا ملک بن جائے گا۔

مزید برآں، رپورٹ میں یہ بھی بتایا گیا ہے کہ افریقی ملک جمہوریہ کانگو مستقبل میں امریکہ کو پیچھے چھوڑ کر دنیا کی سب سے بڑی عیسائی آبادی والا ملک بن سکتا ہے۔ یہ تبدیلیاں آنے والے دہائیوں میں دنیا کی معاشرتی اور مذہبی ساخت کو نمایاں طور پر متاثر کریں گی۔

stories.title: Pakistan Finance Minister Meets APTMA Leaders to Discuss Textile Exports and Growth
stories.summary:
Minister of State for Finance and Railways Bilal Azhar Kayani hosted a delegation of newly elected officials from the All-Pakistan Textile Mills Association (APTMA), led by chairman Asad Shafi, at the Ministry of Finance in Islamabad. The meeting focused on reviewing current industry challenges, improving the overall business climate, and identifying strategies to elevate the sector's export performance and global competitiveness.

During the discussions, the APTMA representatives expressed appreciation for recent relief measures introduced in the federal budget. Specifically, the delegation acknowledged the reduction of export taxes and the elimination of the super tax for small and medium-sized enterprises, thanking the government for facilitating an easier operating environment.

Participants also evaluated various production and financial mechanisms, reviewing the Federal Board of Revenue's Production Monitoring System alongside financing instruments such as the Long-Term Export Growth Financing Facility and the Export Finance Scheme. APTMA offered targeted recommendations to optimize these credit programs to better address the working capital and long-term investment needs of textile exporters.

Concluding the session, the Minister commended the textile sector's vital contribution to the national economy and export volume. Both public and private sector representatives agreed to maintain regular communication to advance brand development, encourage value addition, and ensure sustained export-led economic growth.

stories.title: Pakistan Mango Exports Drop 36 Percent Due to Middle East Conflict and Climate Change
stories.summary:
Pakistan's mango exports suffered a steep decline of 36 percent this year, dropping to 78,000 tonnes from 123,000 tonnes last year, according to figures released by the All Pakistan Fruit and Vegetables Exporters Association on Wednesday. Association head Waheed Ahmed explained that the ongoing US-Iran war severely impacted international trade, reducing the nation's export earnings from roughly $100 million down to $60 million.

The conflict caused months-long disruptions near the Strait of Hormuz, spiking shipping freight rates from a previous range of $1,000 to $1,400 up to $8,000. These maritime bottlenecks delayed shipments of perishable goods and drove down Middle Eastern exports from 36,000 tonnes to 14,500 tonnes, heavily affecting key markets like the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and Qatar, which are major destinations for varieties such as the Chaunsa mango.

In addition to maritime logistics challenges, trade with neighboring Afghanistan faced disruptions due to frequent border closures amid strained political relations. The export slump compounds existing agricultural setbacks stemming from environmental shifts, as the association notes that global warming has driven a 35 percent reduction in overall domestic mango production over the past four years.

Historically, Pakistan ranked sixth globally in mango production, yielding 1.9 million metric tonnes annually until 2018 behind countries like India, China, Thailand, Indonesia, and Mexico. However, the combination of geopolitical conflict, soaring transport expenses, and climate change continues to severely threaten the country's fruit export industry.

stories.title: اسلام آباد پولیس نے جے یو آئی رہنما مفتی ابرار کے وارنٹ جاری کردیے
stories.summary:
جمعیت علمائے اسلام ف کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کے قریبی ساتھی مفتی ابرار کے ناقابل ضمانت وارنٹ گرفتاری جاری کر دیے گئے ہیں۔ عدالت کی جانب سے وارنٹ جاری کیے جانے کے بعد اسلام آباد پولیس نے ان کی گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف مقامات پر چھاپے مارنے کا عمل شروع کر دیا ہے، تاہم تاحال وہ قانون کی گرفت میں نہیں آ سکے۔

مفتی ابرار کے خلاف یہ کارروائی اسلام آباد کے سیکٹر آئی نائن فور میں فاروق اعظم مسجد کے قریب پیش آنے والے ایک واقعے کے تناظر میں کی جا رہی ہے۔ ان پر الزام ہے کہ انہوں نے مبینہ طور پر ایک غیر قانونی اجتماع کی قیادت کی، سڑک کو بند کیا اور پولیس پر پتھراؤ کیا۔ اس حوالے سے تھانہ میں ایف آئی آر نمبر 1212/26 درج کی گئی ہے۔

مقدمے کے متن کے مطابق جے یو آئی ف کے کارکنوں نے بغیر کسی پیشگی اجازت کے اجتماع منعقد کیا۔ جب پولیس نے انہیں روکنے کی کوشش کی تو انہوں نے مبینہ طور پر اہلکاروں پر پتھراؤ کیا، سرکاری گاڑیوں کو نقصان پہنچایا اور سرکاری امور کی انجام میں مداخلت کی۔ مزید الزام یہ بھی ہے کہ اس دوران اسلحے کے زور پر سرکاری اہلکاروں کو ان کے فرائض سے روکا گیا جس سے عام شہریوں اور قریبی فلیٹس کے مکینوں کی جان و مال خطرے میں پڑ گئی۔

اسلام آباد کی ایک خصوصی انسداد دہشت گردی عدالت نے اس معاملے کی سماعت کے بعد انسداد دہشت گردی ایکٹ کی دفعہ سات سمیت دیگر سنگین دفعات کے تحت مفتی ابرار کے ناقابل ضمانت وارنٹ گرفتاری جاری کیے۔ عدالتی حکم نامے کے اجرا کے فوراً بعد پولیس نے متحرک ہو کر چھاپے مارنے شروع کر دیے ہیں تاکہ نامزد ملزم کو گرفتار کر کے عدالت میں پیش کیا جا سکے لیکن تاحال ان کی گرفتاری عمل میں نہیں آئی ہے۔

stories.title: Bilawal Defends Recent Remarks and Warns Government Against Forcing New Provinces
stories.summary:
During a television interview on Hum News, PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari doubled down on his previous statements regarding Pakistan's political landscape, urging government leaders to cultivate the patience to listen to differing views. He argued that as a major stakeholder and coalition partner, his proposals for a political reset to handle mounting economic challenges should be heard and considered rather than dismissed. Bilawal noted that his warnings were framed around the global economic pressures and energy costs stemming from the US-Iran conflict, contrasting the struggles of regular Pakistanis with the disconnect of the elite.

Bilawal expressed frustration that the debate over creating new provinces had bypassed parliament entirely, having instead been initiated in front of business groups. Questioning the multitude of fronts the government has chosen to fight on—including adversaries like India, regional friction with Afghanistan, domestic terrorism, and political opponents like the PTI and JUI—Bilawal asked who would manage the severe economic crisis if internal conflicts continued to multiply. He further criticized the state's harsh reactions to political dissent, specifically citing the pressure applied against Maulana Fazlur Rehman's party workers.

Addressing the potential division of Sindh, Bilawal clarified that while the PPP is a peaceful party, forcing administrative splits would inevitably generate severe societal and political consequences that could damage the federation. He firmly stated that ultimate decision-making power rests solely with Allah, rejecting the notion that a settled decree can be imposed without social fallout. He also reiterated that the PCB chairman held no mandate to dictate governance structures or political resets.

When questioned about the stability of the ruling coalition, Bilawal stated he had no extraordinary attachment to treasury benches and would not lose sleep if he moved to the opposition if the government lacked the courage to heed constructive advice from its allies. However, he clarified that his party currently stands with the administration to keep national interests in view and to strengthen Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's hand.

stories.title: Iran Targets US Sites in Kuwait Following American Airstrike on Qeshm Island
stories.summary:
Regional hostilities escalated significantly as Iran launched overnight attacks targeting US drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem air base. The strike followed an American airstrike executed by fighter aircraft against a missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. US military officials confirmed that all service members remained safe and accounted for with no injuries reported from the week's Iranian attacks, while Iranian media reported that the US strike caused no infrastructure damage. Meanwhile, Bahrain announced it had intercepted Iranian aerial attacks for the third time in a week, condemning Tehran's hostile approach toward the Gulf kingdom where the US Navy's Fifth Fleet is headquartered.

These military developments further complicate ongoing international diplomatic efforts aimed at quelling a broader conflict that has severely destabilized the Middle East, disrupted vital maritime shipping, and driven up global energy costs. Iranian Army Commander-in-Chief Amir Hatami issued stern warnings to the United States, declaring that Tehran possesses the readiness to counter any repeated military mistakes much more forcefully. Middle East policy experts noted that while Iran's escalation has been cautious so far, the risk of a wider confrontation remains high if the United States expands its targeting scope deep into Iranian territory.

The wider regional conflict encompasses ongoing fallout from earlier direct clashes between Iran, Israel, and various regional proxies, including Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Houthis in Yemen. Commercial shipping has faced continuous threats, highlighted by a recent attack on an ADNOC Logistics vessel in the Strait of Hormuz that left one crew member missing and eleven injured, alongside a tanker abandonment off Oman's Khasab. Concurrently, diplomatic channels remain active, with Qatari and Iranian officials holding discussions to narrow proposal gaps, while Saudi Arabia reiterated its call for international law, good neighborliness, and negotiated peace.

stories.title: Bilawal Warns PPP May Exit Ruling Coalition Over Disregarded Concerns
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari indicated that his party is prepared to leave the ruling coalition and join the opposition benches if the PML-N-led government continues to ignore the perspectives and grievances of its allies. Speaking in a television interview, Bilawal defended his previous assertions regarding governance, insisting he spoke the truth and urging state representatives to tolerate constructive feedback. He reiterated the necessity for a democratic reset aimed at resolving pressing public issues like inflation and unemployment rather than fixating on polarizing administrative matters.

The controversy intensified after Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi proposed establishing new provinces and administrative units in July, a concept later supported by other officials like Defence Minister Khawaja Asif. This initiative faced fierce pushback from the PPP, which governs Sindh and adamantly opposes any partition of the province. Bilawal argued that these governance debates should be handled transparently within parliament rather than introduced before business forums, and warned that attempting to forcefully divide Sindh could trigger uncontrollable civil unrest.

Placing the political situation within the context of global economic strains caused by the US-Iran conflict, Bilawal criticized the nation's political elite for remaining detached from the hardships faced by everyday citizens. He argued that being part of the ruling alliance grants the PPP greater standing to offer corrective proposals, making it vital for the administration to listen. Furthermore, he questioned why the government chose to open multiple internal and external political battles simultaneously against opposition factions like the PTI and JUI-F while the nation struggles through a historic economic crisis.

Bilawal also expressed concern over the government's heavy-handed tactics against political opponents, citing the harassment of Maulana Fazlur Rehman's family and workers as irresponsible behavior. While maintaining that his party still supports Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and wishes to strengthen his government, Bilawal made it clear that he will not hesitate to transition to the opposition if his party's well-meaning input continues to be disregarded by the administration.

stories.title: Bilawal warns PPP may join opposition if allies are ignored
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari warned on Wednesday that his party could leave the ruling coalition and join the opposition benches if the PML-N-led government refuses to heed the concerns of its political allies. Speaking during a television interview, Bilawal defended his recent political remarks, urging government representatives to develop the courage to listen to differing opinions and the truth.

The political debate intensified following a July proposal by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi to create new administrative units and provinces, a move strongly rejected by the PPP, which governs Sindh. Bilawal argued that such divisions would not solve the nation's underlying issues and cautioned that forcibly splitting Sindh could trigger serious unrest. He criticized the government for opening multiple political fronts during a severe economic crisis rather than fostering unity.

The PPP chairman questioned why governance discussions were initiated with business groups rather than brought to parliament. He asserted that being part of the ruling coalition does not strip his party of its right to critique policies, maintaining that the government must take stock of the situation. Bilawal also dismissed suggestions that his remarks indicated a confrontational approach, emphasizing instead the need for a democratic reset to address poverty, inflation, and unemployment.

Bilawal noted that neither the prime minister nor other federal stakeholders had discussed the restructuring proposal with him or President Asif Ali Zardari. He criticized federal ministers for lacking tolerance toward criticism and warned that any forced division of Sindh would severely aggravate the regional law and order situation.

stories.title: Punjab Restaurants Face Penalties and Closure Orders Without Kitchen Suction Hoods
stories.summary:
Restaurant owners throughout Punjab have received official warnings that their businesses will face strict financial penalties and potential closure if they do not install suction hoods in their kitchens. The Punjab Home Department stated that implementing these filtration systems is a mandatory requirement designed to control air pollution and mitigate worsening smog conditions across the region.

The regulation applies broadly to commercial food establishments, including restaurant kitchens, barbecue outlets, and wedding halls. A suction hood functions as an essential ventilation and filtration unit mounted directly above cooking zones to intercept smoke, grease, and microscopic airborne particles before they escape into the open air.

Commercial kitchens that rely on wood and coal for cooking generate substantial quantities of smoke and harmful carbon emissions. These operations release fine particulate matter, notably PM2.5 pollutants, which degrade local air quality and intensify regional pollution levels.

By mandating the adoption of commercial suction hoods, authorities intend to capture and filter out hazardous smoke emissions at the source. The enforcement action represents a direct measure by the government to curb environmental pollution stemming from commercial food preparation activities.

stories.title: Modi’s Attempt to Shut Down Press Briefing in Manila Sparks Global Debate
stories.summary:
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi triggered widespread international debate concerning political accountability and media relations during an incident at the Quad leaders’ summit in Manila. The event occurred during a pre-planned group photo session ahead of a private 90-minute summit, featuring Modi alongside US President Donald Trump, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.

As reporters directed unexpected questions toward President Trump concerning Iran, Nvidia, and the world economy, Prime Minister Modi appeared visibly impatient. He leaned toward the other leaders and whispered, "Shall we move?" in an apparent attempt to herd journalists away from the group. However, the maneuver failed when neither Trump nor the other leaders complied with his suggestion.

President Trump continued answering inquiries for several additional minutes before turning to Takaichi and Modi to remark on the toughness of the questions, jokingly calling Modi a "tough man." While Takaichi nodded in agreement, Modi maintained a stone-faced expression throughout the remainder of the press conference. The video clip quickly went viral globally within hours.

Political experts and opposition leaders responded with harsh commentary, highlighting the episode as further proof of Modi's well-documented avoidance of unauthorized media interactions. Critics noted that he has consistently sidestepped holding independent press conferences domestically throughout his tenure as prime minister.

stories.title: Punjab CM Announces Expedited Courts and New Laws to Protect Women and Children
stories.summary:
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has announced the establishment of expedited courts aimed at safeguarding women and children. Alongside these specialized courts, a new legislative proposal will be introduced to ensure exemplary punishment for individuals who exploit women and children, as effective measures are deemed necessary to guarantee their safety, dignity, and future.

The announcement was made during a speech marking the World Day for the Prevention of and Healing from Child Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Violence. The chief minister emphasized that protecting children from sexual exploitation, abuse, and all forms of violence is a collective societal duty. She stressed that violence against children transcends ordinary criminality to become a direct violation of human dignity, declaring that perpetrators are enemies of society who must face strict legal consequences.

To bolster safety measures, the Punjab government has deployed Safe City cameras and panic buttons across the province. Additionally, Virtual Child Safety Centres have been established throughout the region to protect young people. Through these various initiatives, authorities have successfully reunited nearly 100,000 families with their missing and kidnapped children.

The creation of these speedy courts and stricter laws forms part of an ongoing regional effort to address crimes against vulnerable populations. By combining technological surveillance via Safe City infrastructure with targeted judicial reforms, the administration seeks to enforce accountability and deter future offenses across Punjab.

stories.title: صوبے بنانے کی بحث میں نے شروع نہیں کی، بلاول بھٹو
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے ایک انٹرویو میں کہا ہے کہ سسٹم کولپس، سسٹم ری سیٹ اور ریفرنڈم کے ذریعے نئے صوبے بنانے کی بحث انہوں نے خود شروع نہیں کی۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اگر اس قسم کی باتیں چھڑی جائیں گی تو اس سے یہ ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ اس معاملے پر کوئی ایک متفقہ آواز موجود نہیں ہے۔ انہوں نے وضاحت کی کہ اگر کوئی نظام کو تبدیل یا ری سیٹ کرنا چاہتا ہے تو اس کا تعلق سیاسی یا جمہوری عمل سے ہونا چاہیے۔

بلاول بھٹو نے مزید کہا کہ انہوں نے 27 ویں آئینی ترمیم کو مسترد نہیں کیا اور 18ویں ترمیم کی طرح وہ بھی اسے اتفاق رائے سے منظور کرانا چاہتے تھے۔ انہوں نے زور دے کر کہا کہ اگر سیاسی ری سیٹ کے تناظر میں مخصوص نشستیں تحریک انصاف کو واپس دی جاتی ہیں تو یہ اعتماد سازی کے لیے ایک بہتر قدم ہوگا۔ انہوں نے یہ بھی واضح کیا کہ اگر صوبوں کی زبردستی یا غیر آئینی طریقے سے تقسیم کی گئی تو اس سے ملک میں امن و امان کی سنگین صورتحال پیدا ہوسکتی ہے، اور وہ کسی دھمکی کے بجائے زمینی حقائق اور خطرے کی گھنٹی بجا رہے ہیں۔

پی پی پی چیئرمین کا کہنا تھا کہ ملک کو اس وقت سنگین معاشی اور عوامی مسائل کا سامنا ہے جن پر پارلیمنٹ میں کوئی بات نہیں کی جا رہی، اور ان مسائل کا حل کسی ایک جماعت کے بس کی بات نہیں ہے بلکہ تمام اسٹیک ہولڈرز کو ایک ساتھ مل کر بیٹھنا ہوگا۔ انہوں نے خیبرپختونخوا میں گورنر راج کے حوالے سے بات کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ ان کی پوری کوشش تھی کہ وہاں یہ قدم نہ اٹھایا جائے کیونکہ دہشت گردی ان کے لیے ایک ریڈ لائن کی حیثیت رکھتی ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ تحریک انصاف کے ساتھ مذاکرات وہیں سے دوبارہ شروع کیے جا سکتے ہیں جہاں گورنر راج لگنے سے پہلے کا معاملہ تھا۔

آخر میں انہوں نے سندھ حکومت کی کارکردگی کا دفاع کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ صوبے کے تعلیمی نظام کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے سیلاب سے متاثرہ اسکولوں کو دوبارہ تعمیر کیا جا رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے گلہ کیا کہ 18ویں ترمیم اور این ایف سی ایوارڈ کے باوجود صوبوں کو ان کا پورا حق نہیں دیا گیا، اور پیٹرولیم لیوی کی مد میں سندھ کے اربوں روپے ابھی تک نہیں ملے جنہیں تعلیمی اور ترقیاتی منصوبوں پر خرچ کیا جا सकता تھا۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Postpones Planned Visit to Karachi
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has postponed his scheduled Friday visit to Karachi, according to reports from sources. No alternative date has been announced yet for the rescheduled trip.

The decision to delay the visit emerged from a meeting held in Lahore between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari. Prior to this, delegations from the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) and the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) had reached an agreement at the Prime Minister’s House stipulating that the prime minister would travel to Karachi.

During the planned trip, the prime minister was scheduled to participate in a high-level meeting alongside several other engagements. These discussions were intended to address and resolve multiple pending issues between the PPP and the PML-N, specifically focusing on matters involving the federation and the provinces.

Although the political stakeholders had previously agreed on the itinerary to iron out inter-party and federal-provincial differences, the visit is currently on hold. Federal and provincial authorities have yet to indicate when the prime minister will reschedule his engagements in Karachi.

stories.title: Submarine Cable Fault Disrupts Internet Connectivity Across Pakistan
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) reported that a fault in an international submarine cable system may cause internet users to encounter intermittent connectivity issues and a decline in service quality. The disruption stems from the SEA-ME-WE 5 (SMW5) cable system, which registered a fault approximately 11 kilometers away from Pakistan's shore.

Transworld Associates is currently working alongside the SMW5 consortium to pinpoint the root cause of the breakdown and calculate an estimated timeline for full restoration. In the interim, the PTA stated that internet traffic is being successfully rerouted through alternative international pathways to mitigate the impact and maintain service continuity to the highest possible degree.

Internet monitor NetBlocks verified that the drop in performance was causing slower service, noting that the incident aligns with a subsea cable failure prompting operators to seek alternative routing. This follows a previous incident on July 1, when another fault on the same SMW5 system triggered widespread connectivity disruptions in Pakistan before being resolved two days later on July 3.

The PTA confirmed it is maintaining close communication with all relevant stakeholders and will continue observing the situation closely to ensure normal internet operations are restored nationwide as swiftly as possible.

stories.title: Punjab Approves Panchayat System to Resolve Local Disputes and Ease Court Backlogs
stories.summary:
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has granted in-principle approval to establish a panchayat system designed to manage local disputes through reconciliation, mediation, and amicable settlements. During a special meeting chaired by the chief minister, officials outlined plans to form panchayat committees at the village, union council, locality, and mauza levels with the consent of all involved parties.

Deputy commissioners will select permanent area residents to serve as members based on their objectivity, discernment, and reputation. The proposed membership is slated to include educators, retired judges, lambardars, former military officers, retired public servants, and other respected community figures. Operating within strict legal guidelines, the framework aims to improve justice accessibility for women, minorities, and marginalized or poor communities.

To prevent potential misuse against vulnerable groups and women, authorities will issue a negative list outlining matters that fall outside the jurisdiction of the panchayats. The framework ensures that citizens' right to judicial protection remains intact and does not undermine the authority of formal courts. Chief Minister Sharif instructed officials to draft comprehensive regulations and policy guidelines to define the exact powers and responsibilities of the committees.

The initiative revives Punjab's traditional practice of addressing minor conflicts via community mediation and mutual understanding. By introducing the Punjab Panchayat Act, the government hopes to provide an accessible, affordable, and straightforward legal framework that empowers local citizens in decision-making, brings inexpensive justice closer to communities, and reduces the heavy case loads currently burdening the courts.

stories.title: Pakistan Grants Exemption on Financial Instruments for Potato and Kinnow Exports to Russia
stories.summary:
The government of Pakistan has approved a one-time exemption from the financial instrument requirement for exports of kinnow and potatoes to the Russian Federation via land and sea routes. According to an official memorandum, the policy applies to specific product categories, including potatoes under HS Code 0701.9000, kinnow and mandarins under 0805.2100, and other mandarins under 0805.2910, remaining effective until May 15, 2027.

A financial instrument serves as a payment, credit, or risk-mitigation arrangement—such as an advance payment, export contract, Letter of Credit, or documentary collection—designed to secure payments and manage trade risks between buyers and sellers. Pakistan previously issued a similar exemption in December 2025 for potato and kinnow shipments directed to Commonwealth of Independent States member countries through Iran's land route. Bilateral ties further progressed in February when Pakistan and Russia agreed to boost regional economic activity through direct land and air links, followed by Russia permitting Punjab potato imports in April after previous phytosanitary restrictions.

Potato cultivation in Pakistan has experienced rapid expansion over the past decade, with farming land growing by roughly 160% from approximately 177,700 hectares in 2015-16 to 462,160 hectares in 2025-26, producing a harvest of about 12 million tonnes. Meanwhile, the kinnow export season runs from December to April with peaks in January and February. Industry associations previously targeted 300,000 tonnes of kinnow exports to generate $110 million, while experts suggest overall earnings could reach $400 million within five years through improved supply chains and new citrus varieties.

stories.title: Pakistan grants trade exemption for potato and kinnow exports
stories.summary:
The government of Pakistan has approved a one-time exemption from financial instrument requirements for exporting potatoes and kinnow to the Russian Federation through both land and sea routes. The policy, effective until May 15, 2027, covers three specific product categories: potatoes, kinnow or mandarins, and other mandarins. Financial instruments like letters of credit or advance payments typically manage trade risks and secure payments between exporters and buyers.

This decision follows a similar exemption granted in December 2025 for exports to Commonwealth of Independent States member countries routed through Iran. Earlier this year, Pakistan and Russia agreed to expand direct land and air links to boost regional trade. Furthermore, the Russian Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Surveillance permitted potato imports from Punjab province in April, lifting phytosanitary restrictions that had been active since May 2025.

Agricultural expansion over the past decade has driven significant growth in these key sectors. Land dedicated to potato cultivation surged by approximately 160 percent over ten years, reaching roughly 462,160 hectares and yielding a harvest of about 12 million tonnes for the 2025-26 season. Meanwhile, the kinnow season runs from December to April, peaking in January and February.

Industry associations previously set an ambitious export target of 300,000 tonnes of kinnow, projecting $110 million in foreign exchange earnings. Sector experts believe that improving supply chains and introducing new citrus varieties could scale Pakistan's overall export earnings to $400 million within a five-year span.

stories.title: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 Launches Globally to Generational Critical Acclaim
stories.summary:
Global critics and media outlets, including the BBC, have delivered widespread praise for Rockstar's latest blockbuster release, Grand Theft Auto 6, earning it an elite rating on aggregate. Set within the rich environment of Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida, the title introduces Lucia, the franchise's first modern 3D female protagonist, alongside her partner, Jason. Reviewers highlighted the project for its emotional depth, believable characters, detailed world-building, and an advanced NPC artificial intelligence system that generates a vibrant virtual environment.
